h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in Louisiana? Here Are Your 2026 Health Insurance Options
h1.es: ¿Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Luisiana? Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of job-based coverage to enroll in a new plan. Louisiana's Healthy Louisiana Medicaid is free if your income now falls under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, about $22,025 for a single person in 2026.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del trabajo para inscribirse en un nuevo plan. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid es gratuito si su ingreso cae bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, aproximadamente $22,025 para una persona en 2026.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your Louisiana coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Luisiana

body.en: Your 60-day Marketplace SEP window runs from your last day of job-based coverage through 60 days later. For example, if your Louisiana employer coverage ends July 1, 2026, your SEP window closes August 30, 2026. Miss that deadline and you wait until ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 for January 2027 coverage. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid has no deadline and enrolls year-round at the Louisiana Department of Health.
body.es: Su ventana SEP del Mercado de 60 dias va desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del trabajo hasta 60 dias despues. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura del empleador de Luisiana termina el 1 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP cierra el 30 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa fecha limite espera hasta la Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre de 2026. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid no tiene fecha limite y se inscribe todo el ano.

label.es: Plan del empleador del conyuge (Luisiana o fuera del estado)
Healthy Louisiana Medicaid (si el ingreso califica)

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based coverage in Louisiana triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans. Louisiana expanded Medicaid in 2016, so if your projected 2026 income falls under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level (roughly $22,025 for one person or $45,540 for a family of four), you can enroll in Healthy Louisiana Medicaid for free at any time of year. For higher-income households, ACA Marketplace plans through healthcare.gov typically cost $10 to $300 per month after premium tax credits. COBRA continues your old Louisiana plan at 102% of the full premium, often $500 to $2,000 per month, and is rarely the best choice once Marketplace subsidies are factored in. Children may qualify for LaCHIP at incomes up to 217% of the Federal Poverty Level regardless of what you choose for yourself.
quickAnswer.es: Perder cobertura del trabajo en Luisiana activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del Mercado ACA. Luisiana expandio Medicaid en 2016, asi que si su ingreso proyectado en 2026 cae bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (aproximadamente $22,025 para una persona o $45,540 para familia de cuatro), puede inscribirse en Healthy Louisiana Medicaid gratis en cualquier momento del ano. Para hogares con ingresos mas altos, los planes del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov cuestan tipicamente $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima. COBRA continua su plan de Luisiana al 102% de la prima completa, a menudo $500 a $2,000 al mes, y rara vez es la mejor opcion cuando se consideran los subsidios del Mercado. Los ninos pueden calificar para LaCHIP con ingresos hasta el 217% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza sin importar lo que usted elija.

introParagraphs.en: Louisiana job loss is a qualifying life event that opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period under federal ACA law. Three coverage pathways open the moment your employer-based plan ends: Healthy Louisiana Medicaid for those whose income drops under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, ACA Marketplace plans through healthcare.gov for everyone else, and COBRA continuation of your old plan for up to 18 months. Louisiana expanded Medicaid under the ACA in June 2016, which means the state's Healthy Louisiana program now covers roughly 1.7 million Louisianans, many of them adults who gained eligibility only after expansion. That expansion matters enormously for people who just lost a job in Louisiana: a sudden income drop from a salary to zero or to unemployment benefits often pushes a household below the 138% FPL Medicaid threshold, where coverage is free and year-round with no enrollment deadline. For 2026, the Healthy Louisiana Medicaid threshold for a single adult is $22,025 in annual income, or $1,836 per month, based on the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines. For a family of four, the threshold is $45,540 annually. Applying online at medicaid.louisiana.gov or through healthcare.gov takes about 20 minutes and triggers an eligibility determination within days.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Luisiana es un evento calificador de vida que abre un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias bajo la ley ACA federal. Tres vias de cobertura se abren en el momento en que termina su plan del empleador: Healthy Louisiana Medicaid para quienes su ingreso cae bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, planes del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov para todos los demas, y la continuacion COBRA de su plan anterior por hasta 18 meses. Luisiana expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA en junio de 2016, lo que significa que el programa Healthy Louisiana del estado ahora cubre aproximadamente 1.7 millones de luisianeses, muchos adultos que solo obtuvieron elegibilidad despues de la expansion. Esa expansion es enormemente importante para personas que acaban de perder un trabajo en Luisiana: una caida repentina de ingresos de un salario a cero o a beneficios de desempleo frecuentemente empuja un hogar bajo el umbral Medicaid del 138% FPL, donde la cobertura es gratuita y disponible todo el ano sin fecha limite de inscripcion. Para 2026, el umbral de Healthy Louisiana Medicaid para un adulto soltero es $22,025 en ingresos anuales, o $1,836 al mes. Para una familia de cuatro, el umbral es $45,540 anuales. Aplicar en linea en medicaid.louisiana.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov toma unos 20 minutos.

introParagraphs.en: Louisiana workers who do not qualify for Healthy Louisiana Medicaid have access to ACA Marketplace plans through the federally run healthcare.gov exchange. The ACA subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired on January 1, 2026, so households above 400% of the Federal Poverty Level (roughly $63,840 for one person or $132,000 for a family of four in 2026) pay unsubsidized premiums. Most recently laid-off Louisiana workers, however, report projected income well below that ceiling due to the income drop that follows job loss. Unemployment compensation counts as income under Modified Adjusted Gross Income rules, so include Louisiana Workforce Commission unemployment payments when you calculate your projected annual income for subsidy purposes. Louisiana Marketplace plan costs vary by parish due to carrier availability, but most subsidized Silver or Bronze plans run $10 to $200 per month for individuals after 2026 premium tax credits. Children in the household can apply for LaCHIP, Louisiana's Children's Health Insurance Program, which covers kids under 19 at household incomes up to 217% of the Federal Poverty Level at no premium and up to 257% FPL through the LaCHIP Affordable Plan at $50 per month. The Medicaid income limits for 2026 appear in the table below.
introParagraphs.es: Los trabajadores de Luisiana que no califican para Healthy Louisiana Medicaid tienen acceso a planes del Mercado ACA a traves del intercambio federal healthcare.gov. El precipicio de subsidios del ACA regreso para 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que los hogares por encima del 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (aproximadamente $63,840 para una persona o $132,000 para una familia de cuatro en 2026) pagan primas sin subsidio. Sin embargo, la mayoria de trabajadores de Luisiana recien despedidos reportan ingresos proyectados bien por debajo de ese techo debido a la caida de ingresos que sigue a la perdida de empleo. La compensacion por desempleo cuenta como ingreso bajo las reglas de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado, asi que incluya los pagos de desempleo de la Comision de Fuerza Laboral de Luisiana al calcular su ingreso anual proyectado. Los costos de los planes del Mercado de Luisiana varian por parroquia, pero la mayoria de planes Silver o Bronze subsidiados cuestan $10 a $200 al mes para individuos despues de los creditos fiscales de prima 2026. Los ninos pueden solicitar LaCHIP, el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos de Luisiana, que cubre ninos menores de 19 con ingresos del hogar hasta el 217% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza sin prima.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 Louisiana household income
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar de Luisiana para 2026

text.en: Use only what your household will actually earn going forward in 2026, not your former Louisiana salary. Count Louisiana Workforce Commission unemployment benefits as income. If you expect $0 earned income for the rest of the year, annualize only unemployment payments. Lower projected income means a larger Marketplace subsidy or free Healthy Louisiana Medicaid. ACA premium tax credits are based on projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income, not prior-year income.
text.es: Use solo lo que su hogar realmente ganara en 2026, no su salario anterior en Luisiana. Cuente los beneficios de desempleo de la Comision de Fuerza Laboral de Luisiana como ingreso. Si espera $0 de ingresos ganados por el resto del ano, anualice solo los pagos de desempleo. Menor ingreso proyectado significa un mayor subsidio del Mercado o Healthy Louisiana Medicaid gratuito.

name.en: Check Healthy Louisiana Medicaid eligibility first
name.es: Verifique primero la elegibilidad de Healthy Louisiana Medicaid

text.en: Apply at medicaid.louisiana.gov or through healthcare.gov. In 2026, Louisiana's Healthy Louisiana Medicaid covers adults aged 19 to 64 with incomes at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: $22,025 for one person, $29,863 for two, $37,702 for three, or $45,540 for a family of four. Healthy Louisiana is free with no premiums. Enrollment is year-round with no SEP deadline. Louisiana operates managed-care Medicaid through five plans under the Healthy Louisiana umbrella.
text.es: Solicite en medicaid.louisiana.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov. En 2026, Healthy Louisiana Medicaid cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos iguales o inferiores al 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: $22,025 para una persona, $29,863 para dos, $37,702 para tres, o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. Healthy Louisiana es gratuito sin primas. La inscripcion es durante todo el ano sin fecha limite SEP.

name.en: If income is above Medicaid, compare ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov
name.es: Si el ingreso esta por encima de Medicaid, compare planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and submit a Marketplace SEP application within 60 days of losing Louisiana job-based coverage. Enter your projected 2026 household income to see your premium tax credit eligibility. Most Louisiana enrollees between 138% and 400% of the Federal Poverty Level will find subsidized Silver plans under $150 per month after the 2026 premium tax credit. Compare provider networks by parish: Louisiana Marketplace carriers include Blue Cross Blue Shield of Louisiana, Vantage Health Plan, and others depending on your zip code.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y envie una solicitud de SEP del Mercado dentro de los 60 dias de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Luisiana. Ingrese su ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026 para ver su elegibilidad para el credito fiscal de prima. La mayoria de los inscritos de Luisiana entre el 138% y el 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza encontraran planes Silver subsidiados por menos de $150 al mes despues del credito fiscal de prima 2026.

name.en: Check LaCHIP for children in your Louisiana household
name.es: Verifique LaCHIP para los ninos en su hogar de Luisiana

text.en: LaCHIP, Louisiana's Children's Health Insurance Program, covers uninsured children under age 19 at household incomes up to 217% of the Federal Poverty Level at no premium. The LaCHIP Affordable Plan extends to 257% FPL for a $50 monthly household premium. Apply for LaCHIP at the same time as Medicaid at medicaid.louisiana.gov or call 1-877-252-2447. Children's LaCHIP enrollment is year-round regardless of any adult Marketplace SEP deadline.
text.es: LaCHIP, el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos de Luisiana, cubre ninos no asegurados menores de 19 anos con ingresos del hogar hasta el 217% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza sin prima. El Plan Economico LaCHIP se extiende hasta el 257% FPL por una prima mensual de $50 por hogar. Solicite LaCHIP al mismo tiempo que Medicaid en medicaid.louisiana.gov o llame al 1-877-252-2447.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA as a temporary fallback only
name.es: Evaluar COBRA solo como respaldo temporal

text.en: Your former Louisiana employer must offer COBRA continuation under federal law if they had 20 or more employees. COBRA charges 102% of the full premium (both employer and employee share plus 2% admin fee), typically $500 to $2,000 per month for an individual or $1,200 to $2,800 for family coverage. COBRA lasts up to 18 months for job-loss events. Consider COBRA only if you are mid-treatment with a Louisiana specialist who is not in any 2026 Marketplace network, or if you have already met a large deductible for the 2026 calendar year.
text.es: Su antiguo empleador de Luisiana debe ofrecer continuacion COBRA bajo la ley federal si tenia 20 o mas empleados. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa (tanto la parte del empleador como la del empleado mas el 2% de tarifa administrativa), tipicamente $500 a $2,000 al mes para un individuo o $1,200 a $2,800 para cobertura familiar. COBRA dura hasta 18 meses para eventos de perdida de trabajo. Considere COBRA solo si esta en tratamiento con un especialista de Luisiana que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado 2026.

name.en: Gather your documents and enroll before the 60-day Louisiana SEP window closes
name.es: Reuna sus documentos e inscribase antes de que cierre la ventana SEP de 60 dias de Luisiana

text.en: Submit your Marketplace application at healthcare.gov or your Healthy Louisiana Medicaid application at medicaid.louisiana.gov before Day 60. You will need your Louisiana job termination letter or COBRA notice as proof of the qualifying life event, Social Security numbers for all household members, projected 2026 household income documentation, and current Louisiana address for plan availability by parish zip code. For Marketplace plans, you will also receive a 1095-A tax form at year-end to reconcile your premium tax credit on your federal return.
text.es: Envie su solicitud del Mercado en healthcare.gov o su solicitud de Healthy Louisiana Medicaid en medicaid.louisiana.gov antes del Dia 60. Necesitara su carta de terminacion del trabajo de Luisiana o aviso COBRA como prueba del evento calificador, numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar, documentacion de ingresos del hogar proyectados para 2026, y su direccion actual en Luisiana para disponibilidad de planes por codigo postal de parroquia.

name.en: Confirm your plan selection and pay your first premium
name.es: Confirme su seleccion de plan y pague su primera prima

text.en: After enrolling in a Louisiana Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov, your coverage typically starts the first day of the month following your enrollment, or you can request coverage retroactive to the month of the qualifying life event in some cases. Pay your first premium before the plan's due date or coverage will not activate. For Healthy Louisiana Medicaid, coverage usually begins the month of the application. Keep your Marketplace plan 1095-A form for your 2026 federal tax return to reconcile the premium tax credit.
text.es: Despues de inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de Luisiana a traves de healthcare.gov, su cobertura generalmente comienza el primer dia del mes siguiente a su inscripcion. Pague su primera prima antes de la fecha de vencimiento del plan o la cobertura no se activara. Para Healthy Louisiana Medicaid, la cobertura generalmente comienza el mes de la solicitud. Conserve el formulario 1095-A de su plan del Mercado para su declaracion de impuestos federal 2026.

intro.en: The most expensive mistakes Louisiana residents make after losing job-based coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los residentes de Luisiana cometen despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en 2026:

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without checking Healthy Louisiana Medicaid first. Louisiana expanded Medicaid, so many job-loss households now qualify for free Healthy Louisiana coverage. Compare before you pay $500 to $2,000 per month for COBRA.
items.es: Recurrir a COBRA sin verificar primero Healthy Louisiana Medicaid. Luisiana expandio Medicaid, por lo que muchos hogares que pierden el trabajo ahora califican para cobertura gratuita de Healthy Louisiana. Compare antes de pagar $500 a $2,000 al mes por COBRA.

items.en: Reporting your old Louisiana salary instead of projected post-loss income. ACA subsidies are calculated on projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income, not what you earned while employed. Reporting a $60,000 salary when you now have $0 income costs you thousands in foregone subsidies.
items.es: Reportar su salario anterior de Luisiana en lugar del ingreso proyectado post-perdida. Los subsidios del ACA se calculan sobre el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado anual proyectado, no lo que gano mientras estaba empleado. Reportar un salario de $60,000 cuando ahora tiene $0 de ingresos le cuesta miles en subsidios no aprovechados.

items.en: Forgetting to count Louisiana Workforce Commission unemployment payments as income. Unemployment compensation counts toward Modified Adjusted Gross Income for ACA subsidy calculations. Understating income could lead to a year-end tax repayment of advanced premium tax credits.
items.es: Olvidar contar los pagos de desempleo de la Comision de Fuerza Laboral de Luisiana como ingreso. La compensacion por desempleo cuenta hacia el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado para los calculos de subsidios del ACA. Subestimar el ingreso podria llevar a un reembolso de impuestos a fin de ano de los creditos fiscales de prima anticipados.

items.en: Missing the 60-day Louisiana SEP window. Without the Marketplace SEP, you cannot enroll in an ACA plan until November 1, 2026 Open Enrollment at the earliest, leaving you uninsured until January 2027. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid remains year-round, but Marketplace plan access requires the SEP.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias de Luisiana. Sin el SEP del Mercado, no puede inscribirse en un plan ACA hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del 1 de noviembre de 2026 como muy pronto, dejandolo sin seguro hasta enero de 2027. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid sigue siendo durante todo el ano.

items.en: Not enrolling children in LaCHIP separately. Even if you do not qualify for Healthy Louisiana Medicaid yourself, your children under 19 may qualify for LaCHIP at incomes up to 217% FPL at no premium. LaCHIP enrollment is always open and does not share the adult Marketplace 60-day deadline.
items.es: No inscribir a los ninos en LaCHIP por separado. Aunque usted no califique para Healthy Louisiana Medicaid, sus ninos menores de 19 anos pueden calificar para LaCHIP con ingresos hasta el 217% FPL sin prima. La inscripcion a LaCHIP esta siempre abierta.

items.en: Assuming COBRA is your only bridge option. Louisiana small employers with fewer than 20 employees are not required to offer federal COBRA, though some may offer continuation voluntarily. If your Louisiana employer had fewer than 20 workers, confirm COBRA availability before counting on it, and move quickly to a Marketplace or Medicaid application.
items.es: Asumir que COBRA es su unica opcion puente. Los pequenos empleadores de Luisiana con menos de 20 empleados no estan obligados a ofrecer COBRA federal. Si su empleador de Luisiana tenia menos de 20 trabajadores, confirme la disponibilidad de COBRA antes de contar con ella, y actue rapidamente en una solicitud del Mercado o Medicaid.

heading.en: COBRA vs Healthy Louisiana Medicaid vs ACA Marketplace: Which Path is Right for You in 2026?
heading.es: COBRA vs Healthy Louisiana Medicaid vs Mercado ACA: Que Camino es Correcto Para Usted en 2026?

paragraphs.en: Three coverage pathways open the moment Louisiana job-based coverage ends in 2026. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid is the right first stop for anyone whose projected 2026 income falls under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: $22,025 for a single adult or $45,540 for a family of four under the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines. Healthy Louisiana charges no premiums and has no deductible for expansion-eligible adults, making it the clear financial winner for lower-income Louisianans. Enrollment is year-round through medicaid.louisiana.gov or healthcare.gov with no 60-day deadline.
paragraphs.es: Tres vias de cobertura se abren en el momento en que termina la cobertura del trabajo en Luisiana en 2026. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid es la primera parada correcta para cualquier persona cuyo ingreso proyectado de 2026 cae bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: $22,025 para un adulto soltero o $45,540 para una familia de cuatro bajo las pautas de pobreza HHS 2026. Healthy Louisiana no cobra primas y no tiene deducible para adultos elegibles de expansion, lo que lo convierte en el claro ganador financiero para los luisianeses de menores ingresos.

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace plans through healthcare.gov are the best option for Louisiana households whose projected 2026 income sits between 138% and 400% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 to $63,840 for a single person). After the 2026 premium tax credit, most subsidized Silver plans in Louisiana cost $10 to $200 per month depending on parish, age, and income. The ACA subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits expired January 1, 2026, meaning households above 400% FPL ($63,840 single / $132,000 family of four) pay unsubsidized premiums. The critical restriction: the Marketplace SEP is 60 days from your Louisiana coverage loss date. Apply at healthcare.gov before that window closes.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov son la mejor opcion para hogares de Luisiana cuyo ingreso proyectado de 2026 se ubica entre el 138% y el 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 a $63,840 para una persona). Despues del credito fiscal de prima 2026, la mayoria de planes Silver subsidiados en Luisiana cuestan $10 a $200 al mes segun la parroquia, edad e ingreso. El precipicio de subsidios ACA regreso para 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026.

paragraphs.en: COBRA continuation preserves your former Louisiana employer's plan at 102% of the full premium, employer and employee shares combined, plus a 2% administrative fee. For a typical Louisiana individual plan, that runs $500 to $900 per month; family COBRA often reaches $1,200 to $2,800 per month. COBRA makes sense in a narrow set of circumstances: you are actively receiving treatment from a Louisiana specialist who is out of every 2026 Marketplace network in your parish, or you have already met a substantial portion of your 2026 deductible and want to preserve continuity through year-end. For almost everyone else, Healthy Louisiana Medicaid or a subsidized Marketplace plan is the financially superior choice. Louisiana employers under 20 employees are exempt from federal COBRA requirements, so confirm availability if your former employer was small.
paragraphs.es: La continuacion COBRA preserva el plan de su antiguo empleador de Luisiana al 102% de la prima completa, partes del empleador y empleado combinadas, mas una tarifa administrativa del 2%. Para un plan individual tipico de Luisiana, eso es $500 a $900 al mes; COBRA familiar a menudo alcanza $1,200 a $2,800 al mes. COBRA tiene sentido en un conjunto estrecho de circunstancias: esta recibiendo tratamiento activo de un especialista de Luisiana que esta fuera de todas las redes del Mercado 2026 en su parroquia, o ya ha cumplido una parte sustancial de su deducible 2026.

heading.en: Healthy Louisiana Medicaid Eligibility and Enrollment in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad e Inscripcion en Healthy Louisiana Medicaid en 2026

paragraphs.en: Louisiana's Healthy Louisiana program is the state's managed-care Medicaid platform, covering approximately 1.7 million Louisianans across five managed care organizations as of 2026 after UnitedHealthcare exited the state Medicaid market effective December 31, 2025. Healthy Louisiana expansion covers adults aged 19 to 64 who are not eligible for Medicare, using Modified Adjusted Gross Income rules with no asset test for the expansion population. Pregnant women in Louisiana qualify at up to 194% of the Federal Poverty Level, and Louisiana children qualify for LaCHIP at up to 217% FPL, making Louisiana's Medicaid ecosystem particularly broad-reaching after expansion.
paragraphs.es: El programa Healthy Louisiana de Luisiana es la plataforma de Medicaid gestionada del estado, cubriendo aproximadamente 1.7 millones de luisianeses a traves de cinco organizaciones de atencion administrada a partir de 2026 despues de que UnitedHealthcare salio del mercado de Medicaid estatal efectivo el 31 de diciembre de 2025. La expansion de Healthy Louisiana cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos que no son elegibles para Medicare, usando reglas de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado sin prueba de activos para la poblacion de expansion.

paragraphs.en: Applying for Healthy Louisiana Medicaid after Louisiana job loss takes three steps: first, apply online at medicaid.louisiana.gov or through healthcare.gov, which routes Medicaid applicants to the state agency automatically. Second, provide proof of Louisiana residency, Social Security number, and income documentation, which for someone newly unemployed may be a termination letter plus zero recent pay stubs or a current unemployment award letter. Third, choose a Healthy Louisiana managed-care plan from the five available MCOs after the state approves eligibility. Coverage typically begins the month of the application. Louisiana uses a 12-month continuous eligibility policy for children enrolled in LaCHIP, meaning children do not lose coverage mid-year even if family income rises above the threshold temporarily.
paragraphs.es: Solicitar Healthy Louisiana Medicaid despues de perder un trabajo en Luisiana toma tres pasos: primero, solicite en linea en medicaid.louisiana.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov, que enruta automaticamente a los solicitantes de Medicaid a la agencia estatal. Segundo, proporcione prueba de residencia en Luisiana, numero de Seguro Social, y documentacion de ingresos. Tercero, elija un plan de atencion administrada de Healthy Louisiana de los cinco MCOs disponibles despues de que el estado apruebe la elegibilidad.

paragraphs.en: Louisiana Marketplace SEP applications require proof of the qualifying life event, which for job loss means a termination letter from your Louisiana employer, a COBRA election notice, or a letter from your employer confirming the last date of coverage. Healthcare.gov accepts these documents within 30 days of the application and may provide temporary coverage pending verification. For Healthy Louisiana Medicaid, the Louisiana Department of Health typically verifies income electronically through state wage data, so documentation requirements are lighter, but having your Social Security number, proof of Louisiana residency, and a recent pay stub or unemployment award letter on hand speeds up the process.
paragraphs.es: Las solicitudes de SEP del Mercado de Luisiana requieren prueba del evento calificador de vida, que para la perdida de trabajo significa una carta de terminacion de su empleador de Luisiana, un aviso de eleccion COBRA, o una carta de su empleador confirmando la ultima fecha de cobertura. Healthcare.gov acepta estos documentos dentro de los 30 dias de la solicitud y puede proporcionar cobertura temporal pendiente de verificacion.

heading.en: COBRA vs Healthy Louisiana Medicaid vs ACA Marketplace: The 2026 Decision Matrix
heading.es: COBRA vs Healthy Louisiana Medicaid vs Mercado ACA: La Matriz de Decision 2026

body.en: After losing job-based coverage in Louisiana in 2026, three pathways open simultaneously. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid is free, year-round, and requires no 60-day deadline if income falls under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. ACA Marketplace plans through healthcare.gov are the middle-income path, with 2026 premium tax credits reducing most Louisiana Silver plans to $10 to $200 per month for households between $22,025 and $63,840 annually for a single person. COBRA continuation of your old Louisiana plan costs 102% of the full premium (employer plus employee share plus 2% administrative fee), typically $500 to $2,000 per month for individuals and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for families, and is virtually never the financially optimal choice for someone whose income just dropped sharply. The decision matrix for Louisiana workers: check Healthy Louisiana Medicaid first (free, year-round if income qualifies under 138% FPL for 2026); then check if a spouse's employer plan offers a 30-day SEP (often the cheapest middle-income option); then apply for the Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov before Day 60 (the most common 2026 path for Louisiana workers whose income is above Medicaid but below $63,840); use COBRA only as a last resort when a specific Louisiana provider relationship or a met deductible cannot be replicated in any Marketplace plan. Children in the household should apply for LaCHIP separately regardless of which adult path is chosen.
body.es: Despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Luisiana en 2026, tres vias se abren simultaneamente. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid es gratuito, disponible todo el ano, y no requiere la fecha limite de 60 dias si el ingreso cae bajo el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Los planes del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov son la via de ingresos medios, con creditos fiscales de prima 2026 que reducen la mayoria de planes Silver de Luisiana a $10 a $200 al mes para hogares entre $22,025 y $63,840 anuales para una persona. La continuacion COBRA de su antiguo plan de Luisiana cuesta el 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 al mes para individuos y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para familias, y virtualmente nunca es la opcion financieramente optima para alguien cuyos ingresos acaban de caer bruscamente.

en.question: What is the SEP window after losing my job in Louisiana in 2026?
en.answer: Your Loss-of-Coverage Special Enrollment Period is 60 days from the last day your Louisiana employer-sponsored health insurance is active. For example, if your Louisiana employer coverage ends July 1, 2026, your SEP window runs from July 1 through August 30, 2026. Apply at healthcare.gov during that window to enroll in a 2026 ACA Marketplace plan. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid does not have a 60-day deadline and accepts applications year-round at medicaid.louisiana.gov.

en.question: How do I document Louisiana job loss to qualify for the Marketplace SEP?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov accepts your Louisiana employer termination letter, a COBRA election notice from your former employer's plan administrator, or a written statement from your employer confirming the last date of employer-sponsored coverage. Upload these documents through your healthcare.gov account within 30 days of submitting your SEP application. Louisiana Marketplace SEP applications may receive conditional coverage approval while documents are pending verification, but coverage could be terminated retroactively if documents are not provided.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day Louisiana Marketplace SEP after losing my job?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day Marketplace SEP leaves you without ACA plan access until November 1, 2026, the start of Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage. Coverage would not begin until January 1, 2027. However, Healthy Louisiana Medicaid remains open year-round: if your 2026 income qualifies (under $22,025 for a single adult), apply at medicaid.louisiana.gov at any time. LaCHIP for Louisiana children under 19 is also year-round. COBRA, if elected within its own 60-day election window, can bridge the gap, but at full premium cost.

en.question: Do I qualify for Healthy Louisiana Medicaid after losing my Louisiana job?
en.answer: Louisiana expanded Medicaid in 2016, so the income threshold for adults is 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that is $22,025 per year ($1,836 per month) for a single adult, or $45,540 per year for a family of four. If your projected income after job loss falls under those thresholds, apply at medicaid.louisiana.gov or through healthcare.gov. Louisiana Medicaid uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income rules with no asset test for expansion adults. Unemployment benefits from the Louisiana Workforce Commission count as income in the MAGI calculation.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after losing my Louisiana job?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the best financial choice for Louisiana workers after job loss in 2026. COBRA charges 102% of your former plan's full premium (employer plus employee share plus 2% admin fee), typically $500 to $2,000 per month for an individual in Louisiana. ACA Marketplace plans with premium tax credits typically cost $10 to $200 per month for most Louisiana enrollees whose income drops after job loss. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid is free if income falls under 138% FPL. COBRA makes sense only if you have ongoing treatment with a Louisiana specialist not covered by any 2026 Marketplace plan in your parish, or if you have a large met deductible to protect through the end of the 2026 calendar year.

en.question: Can my children get LaCHIP even if I don't qualify for Healthy Louisiana Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes. LaCHIP, Louisiana's Children's Health Insurance Program, covers children under 19 at household incomes up to 217% of the Federal Poverty Level at no premium. The LaCHIP Affordable Plan extends to 257% FPL for $50 per month per household. LaCHIP enrollment is year-round at medicaid.louisiana.gov or by calling 1-877-252-2447. Apply for LaCHIP at the same time as your Medicaid or Marketplace application. Children's LaCHIP eligibility is independent of adult Marketplace enrollment and has no 60-day SEP deadline.

en.question: Does Louisiana unemployment compensation count as income for ACA subsidies?
en.answer: Yes. Louisiana Workforce Commission unemployment benefits count as income under Modified Adjusted Gross Income rules for ACA premium tax credit calculations. Include your projected annual unemployment benefit amount when reporting household income on healthcare.gov. If you understate income by excluding unemployment benefits, you may owe repayment of advanced premium tax credits when you file your 2026 federal return using Form 8962. Unemployment income does not affect Healthy Louisiana Medicaid eligibility as long as total income remains under 138% FPL.

en.question: What Louisiana Marketplace plan carriers are available in 2026 and do they cover my parish?
en.answer: Louisiana uses the federal healthcare.gov marketplace. In 2026, carriers available in Louisiana parishes include Blue Cross Blue Shield of Louisiana, Vantage Health Plan, and others depending on your zip code and parish. Plan availability and premium costs vary significantly by parish across Louisiana. Enter your Louisiana zip code at healthcare.gov to see which carriers offer plans in your specific area. Confirm that your current Louisiana primary care doctor and any specialists you see are in-network before selecting a 2026 plan, since provider networks differ between carriers and plan tiers.

es.question: Cual es la ventana SEP despues de perder mi trabajo en Luisiana en 2026?
es.answer: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por Perdida de Cobertura es de 60 dias desde el ultimo dia que su seguro medico del empleador de Luisiana esta activo. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura del empleador de Luisiana termina el 1 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP va del 1 de julio al 30 de agosto de 2026. Solicite en healthcare.gov durante esa ventana para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA 2026. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid no tiene fecha limite de 60 dias y acepta solicitudes todo el ano en medicaid.louisiana.gov.

es.question: Como documento la perdida de trabajo en Luisiana para calificar para el SEP del Mercado?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov acepta su carta de terminacion del empleador de Luisiana, un aviso de eleccion COBRA del administrador del plan de su antiguo empleador, o una declaracion escrita de su empleador confirmando la ultima fecha de cobertura patrocinada por el empleador. Cargue estos documentos a traves de su cuenta de healthcare.gov dentro de los 30 dias de enviar su solicitud SEP. Las solicitudes SEP del Mercado de Luisiana pueden recibir aprobacion de cobertura condicional mientras los documentos estan pendientes de verificacion.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP del Mercado de Luisiana de 60 dias despues de perder mi trabajo?
es.answer: Perder el SEP del Mercado de 60 dias lo deja sin acceso al plan ACA hasta el 1 de noviembre de 2026, inicio de la Inscripcion Abierta para cobertura 2027. La cobertura no comenzaria hasta el 1 de enero de 2027. Sin embargo, Healthy Louisiana Medicaid permanece abierto todo el ano: si su ingreso 2026 califica (bajo $22,025 para un adulto soltero), solicite en medicaid.louisiana.gov en cualquier momento. LaCHIP para ninos luisianeses menores de 19 tambien es durante todo el ano.

es.question: Califico para Healthy Louisiana Medicaid despues de perder mi trabajo en Luisiana?
es.answer: Luisiana expandio Medicaid en 2016, por lo que el umbral de ingresos para adultos es el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, eso es $22,025 por ano ($1,836 por mes) para un adulto soltero, o $45,540 por ano para una familia de cuatro. Si su ingreso proyectado despues de la perdida de trabajo cae bajo esos umbrales, solicite en medicaid.louisiana.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov. Luisiana Medicaid usa reglas de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado sin prueba de activos para adultos de expansion. Los beneficios de desempleo de la Comision de Fuerza Laboral de Luisiana cuentan como ingreso.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder mi trabajo en Luisiana?
es.answer: COBRA rara vez es la mejor opcion financiera para los trabajadores de Luisiana despues de perder el trabajo en 2026. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa de su plan anterior, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 al mes para un individuo en Luisiana. Los planes del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima tipicamente cuestan $10 a $200 al mes para la mayoria de los inscritos de Luisiana cuyo ingreso baja despues de perder el trabajo. Healthy Louisiana Medicaid es gratuito si el ingreso cae bajo el 138% FPL.

es.question: Pueden mis ninos obtener LaCHIP aunque yo no califique para Healthy Louisiana Medicaid?
es.answer: Si. LaCHIP, el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos de Luisiana, cubre ninos menores de 19 anos con ingresos del hogar hasta el 217% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza sin prima. El Plan Economico LaCHIP se extiende hasta el 257% FPL por $50 al mes por hogar. La inscripcion a LaCHIP es durante todo el ano en medicaid.louisiana.gov o llamando al 1-877-252-2447. Solicite LaCHIP al mismo tiempo que su solicitud de Medicaid o Mercado.

es.question: La compensacion por desempleo de Luisiana cuenta como ingreso para los subsidios del ACA?
es.answer: Si. Los beneficios de desempleo de la Comision de Fuerza Laboral de Luisiana cuentan como ingreso bajo las reglas de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado para calculos de credito fiscal de prima del ACA. Incluya su monto proyectado de beneficios anuales de desempleo al reportar el ingreso del hogar en healthcare.gov. Si subestima el ingreso excluyendo los beneficios de desempleo, puede deber un reembolso de creditos fiscales de prima anticipados cuando presente su declaracion federal 2026 usando el Formulario 8962.

es.question: Que aseguradoras del Mercado de Luisiana estan disponibles en 2026 y cubren mi parroquia?
es.answer: Luisiana usa el mercado federal healthcare.gov. En 2026, las aseguradoras disponibles en las parroquias de Luisiana incluyen Blue Cross Blue Shield of Louisiana, Vantage Health Plan, y otras dependiendo de su codigo postal y parroquia. La disponibilidad de planes y los costos de prima varian significativamente por parroquia en Luisiana. Ingrese su codigo postal de Luisiana en healthcare.gov para ver que aseguradoras ofrecen planes en su area especifica. Confirme que su medico de atencion primaria actual en Luisiana y cualquier especialista que ve estan en la red antes de seleccionar un plan 2026.
